allowed_claims: The official Zenodo archive passes CRC, recorded MD5, and 125/125 internal SHA-256 records.
Its runnable aggregate script reproduces seven anchors, 15 catch episodes, 14 literature channels, 2,162 events, and 47 sessions byte-for-byte.
The published event ledger supplies a correction/falsification taxonomy, while its own README states that raw session transcripts remain private.
A strict path audit finds none of the 15 ledger rows has its named direct source artifact in the public ZIP.
mandatory_limits: 0/15 direct source-path closure is a structural reconstructability result, not a claim that the curated event summaries are false.
The aggregate counts and event taxonomy come from one research programme and an operator-curated ledger.
Some published scripts still require private transcripts or project-archive inputs.
Aggregate integrity, event routing, decision-evidence sufficiency, and scientific truth are separate objects.
suggested_korean_claim: 두 번째 외부 프로그램의 공개 Zenodo 아카이브는 내부 해시와 집계 재생을 모두 통과했지만, 15개 수정·반증 사건이 지시한 직접 원천 경로는 공개 ZIP에 하나도 포함되지 않았다. 이는 요약 사건의 진위를 부정하는 결과가 아니라, 완전한 집계와 올바른 사건 표적화만으로는 의사결정 근거의 독립 재구성이 보장되지 않음을 보이는 범위 제한 증거다.
affected_surfaces: Proposed Method: require direct evidence-byte closure in decision packets
Experimental Results: separate aggregate replay from 0/15 event-source closure
Limitations: raw transcripts/private inputs and curated ledger
Conclusions: routing and aggregate integrity do not establish sufficiency
citation_gate: do not cite physics findings as verified
